tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a monotone-concave response, but its s_grad span is only 0.018. A low-cost open-branch discriminating probe varies the gradient/branch conditions needed to distinguish candidate sink-inhibited laws before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a saturation/siphon model from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows use nearly identical s_grad, so sink inhibition and branch terms are confounded with the base response.
The horizon is fixed and short relative to no stated long-horizon target; the pilot signatures do not suggest a coupled-memory ODE.
It is explicitly irrelevant to resolving the identified gradient/branch ambiguity.
